messages.author: Salla Signaali
messages.text: Hi Oiva, this reminds me of the clock alarm we had on TRN-042 back in the summer, but I'm on a different box now. Clock sync alarm on xe-0/1/0, it comes up a few times a day.

messages.author: Oiva Oskillaattori
messages.text: TRN-042 was something else, that was a bad cable. What firmware is this one on?

messages.author: Oiva Oskillaattori
messages.text: OK. For xe-0/1/0 on 6.1 I'd check the sync source priority first. If the primary reference is wobbling the alarm tends to come and go like that, and as far as I know it doesn't mean the port is bad. Set the secondary reference properly and watch it for a day before replacing anything.

messages.author: Salla Signaali
messages.text: Will do. I'll set it and check tomorrow.
